q: How does a Ludhiana hosiery unit work out carbon per garment?
title: Ludhiana hosiery: carbon per garment
short: Add electricity and fuel emissions for the month and divide by pieces made, for the making stage. Woollen and acrylic yarn bought in usually carries more and sits in Scope 3; add it from supplier figures per kg, labelled with their source.
audience: Hosiery and knitwear units in the Ludhiana cluster of Punjab

p: Electricity kWh x 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh.
Generator diesel x 2.68 kg CO2 per litre, if used.
Divide by pieces made in the month.
Ask spinners for a figure per kg of yarn. Multiply by yarn weight per garment, including waste.

example.title: Worked example: making stage, one month (illustrative inputs)
example.note: Quantities are illustrative; yarn is not included in this figure.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
